intro: The checkout drop-in component initializer provides options for configuring default behaviors, shipping options, feature flags, language definitions, and extending the default models with new fields and transformers.

defaults.description: Configure default values for billing and shipping method selection.

subsection.title: Set defaults
Set shipping options

features.description: Enable or configure feature flags (e.g., B2B quotes).

subsection.title: Set features
Set language definitions

models.description: Extend the default models (CartModel, CustomerModel) with new fields and transform them as needed.

subsection.title: Set models

CartModel.description: Transforms cart data during checkout including items, pricing, shipping, billing, and payment information. Use this to add custom fields specific to the checkout flow.

CustomerModel.description: Transforms customer data including personal information, addresses, and preferences. Use this to add custom fields or format existing data.
